title: Enterovirus D68 in Europe, 2025: continent-wide predominance of subclade A2/D and shift from pediatric to adult cases
abstract: Abstract Background Enterovirus D68 (EV-D68) has predominantly caused infections in children, and detected cases have mainly been infected by subclade B3. In 2025, however, a substantial number of infections in adults was noted. Aim To detail the molecular epidemiology of the 2025 season in Europe. Methods Case and sequencing data was collected from members in the European Non-Polio Enterovirus Network (ENPEN). The participating sites included both clinical and public health laboratories. Results Data was collected from 13 countries at 23 sites. There were 187 clinical cases infected with EV-D68 and 127 detections in wastewater. Age data were available for 76% (143/187), among which 90 cases were adults. VP1-based genotyping showed subclade A2/D to predominate in all age groups and across all participating countries, as well as in the sewage sampling performed at one site. Two interclade recombinant sequences were detected among 22 whole genome sequences. Conclusion The observed shift towards adult cases and subclade A2/D predominance warrants continued monitoring to determine whether this represents a sustained epidemiological change. The detection of interclade recombinant variants highlights a need to supplement regular VP1-based genotyping with whole-genome sequencing.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the molecular epidemiology of Enterovirus D68 (EV-D68) in Europe during 2025, noting a shift from predominantly pediatric cases to adult cases. The research aimed to detail this change, utilizing data from the European Non-Polio Enterovirus Network (ENPEN) across 13 countries and 23 sites. The study's findings have implications for public health strategies, particularly in tracking and understanding the evolving patterns of EV-D68 infections. However, the study's observational design and limited geographic scope may affect the generalisability of its results, resulting in moderate confidence in the evidence.

abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 肠道病毒D68(EV-D68)主要引起儿童感染,发现病例主要由B3亚支感染。然而,到 2025 年,人们注意到大量成人感染病例。目的 详细介绍 2025 年欧洲赛季的分子 流行病学。方法 从欧洲非脊髓灰质炎肠道病毒网络 (ENPEN) 的成员收集病例和测序数据。参与地点包括临床和公共卫生实验室。结果 数据收集自 13 个国家的 23 个地点。共有187例临床病例感染EV-D68,废水中检出127例。76%(143/187)有年龄数据,其中 90 例为成人。基于 VP1 的基因分型显示,A2/D 分支在所有年龄组和所有参与国家以及在一个地点进行的污水采样中占主导地位。在22个完整的基因组序列中检测到两个交叉重组序列。结论 观察到的向成人病例和 A2/D 分支为主的转变值得继续监测,以确定这是否代表持续的流行病学变化。交叉枝重组变体的检测强调需要用全 基因组 测序来补充常规的基于 VP1 的基因分型。

title: Viral shedding and clinical differences in hand, foot and mouth disease associated with coxsackievirus A16 and coxsackievirus A10
abstract: Hand, foot, and mouth disease (HFMD) remains a major and persistent public health challenge in China and across many parts of Asia. Following widespread implementation of enterovirus A71 vaccination in China, coxsackievirus A10 (CVA10) and coxsackievirus A16 (CVA16) have emerged as the dominant serotypes associated with outbreaks in children. To investigate the viral shedding duration and clinical differences of CVA10 and CVA16 in HFMD outbreaks in Jiangsu Province, and to generate evidence for optimizing case management and outbreak control. In 2024, a total of 63 HFMD cases were prospectively followed daily to monitor symptom progression. Pharyngeal swabs were collected once at symptom onset and on days 3, 7, 10, and 14 post-onset from cases and close contacts. All specimens were tested by RT-PCR for nucleic acid detection and serotype identification. CVA10-infected children had a significantly longer duration (9.5 days) than those with CVA16 (8.0 days, P = 0.012). CVA16 infection correlated with more symptomatic cases, especially higher rash incidence, and increased healthcare-seeking behavior. Viral load dropped sharply from days 1–4, and symptom duration was positively correlated with viral shedding duration in symptomatic children ( r = 0.33); 91.7% of children tested negative within 5 days after symptom resolution. This study suggests that symptom resolution may provide a potential reference for evaluating isolation strategies, early monitoring is critical due to rapid viral load decline, and symptom duration may serve as an indicator of viral RNA shedding duration. Given CVA10’s prolonged viral shedding and CVA16’s symptom-driven transmission, serotype-specific and tailored management strategies may be valuable for HFMD control. However, infectivity was not directly assessed, and these findings should be further validated using viral culture.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 手足口病(HFMD)仍然是中国和亚洲许多地区的一个重大且持续的公共卫生挑战。随着肠道病毒 A71 疫苗接种 在中国的广泛应用,柯萨奇病毒 A10 (CVA10) 和柯萨奇病毒 A16 (CVA16) 已成为儿童中与 暴发 相关的主要血清型。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 探讨江苏省手足口病暴发患者病毒排毒持续时间及CVA10和CVA16的临床差异,为优化病例管理和暴发控制提供依据。2024 年,每天对 63 例手足口病病例进行前瞻性随访,以监测症状进展。
elements_zh.methods: 所有标本均采用RT-PCR进行核酸检测和血清型鉴定。在症状出现时以及发病后第 3、7、10 和 14 天从病例和密切接触者身上采集一次咽拭子。
elements_zh.main_results: CVA10 感染儿童的病程(9.5 天)明显长于 CVA16 感染儿童(8.0 天,P = 0.012)。CVA16 感染与更多症状病例(尤其是更高的皮疹 发病率)以及就医行为增加相关。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这项研究表明,症状缓解可能为评估隔离策略提供潜在参考,由于病毒载量快速下降,早期监测至关重要,症状持续时间可能作为病毒 RNA 脱落持续时间的指标。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 鉴于 CVA10 的病毒排毒时间较长,而 CVA16 的症状驱动型 传播,血清型特异性和定制的管理策略可能对手足口病的控制有价值。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 然而,传染性并未直接评估,这些发现应使用病毒培养进一步验证。

title: Effects of DDX58 Gene Knockdown on EV-A71 Replication and Modulation of RIG-I–Mediated Antiviral
abstract: Abstract Objective: The aim of this study was to investigate the role of DDX58 (RIG-I) in EV-A71 replication and its impact on RIG-I–mediated antiviral signaling responses. Methods: DDX58 knockdown was achieved using siRNA transfection in RD cells, followed by EV-A71 infection. Viral replication and host antiviral responses were assessed by qRT-PCR and Western blotting. The secretion of interferons (IFN-α and IFN-β) and CXCL-10 was measured by ELISA. Results: DDX58 knockdown significantly reduced EV-A71 replication, as indicated by decreased viral RNA levels and VP1 protein expression. Additionally, the expression of key antiviral signaling molecules, including IRF3, IRF7, and CXCL-10, showed a transient increase at 24 hours post-infection, followed by a decline at 36 hours. Consistently, IFN-α and IFN-β levels exhibited a similar time-dependent pattern, with early elevation and subsequent reduction. Conclusion: These findings suggest that DDX58 may exert a context- and time-dependent regulatory effect on EV-A71 replication and antiviral signaling. The observed transient activation of downstream pathways despite DDX58 knockdown indicates potential involvement of compensatory innate immune mechanisms. Further studies are required to elucidate the underlying molecular interactions.

title_zh: DDX58 基因敲低对 EV-A71 复制和 RIG-I 介导的 抗病毒药物 调节的影响
source_body_en: Abstract Objective: The aim of this study was to investigate the role of DDX58 (RIG-I) in EV-A71 replication and its impact on RIG-I–mediated antiviral signaling responses. Methods: DDX58 knockdown was achieved using siRNA transfection in RD cells, followed by EV-A71 infection. Viral replication and host antiviral responses were assessed by qRT-PCR and Western blotting. The secretion of interferons (IFN-α and IFN-β) and CXCL-10 was measured by ELISA. Results: DDX58 knockdown significantly reduced EV-A71 replication, as indicated by decreased viral RNA levels and VP1 protein expression. Additionally, the expression of key antiviral signaling molecules, including IRF3, IRF7, and CXCL-10, showed a transient increase at 24 hours post-infection, followed by a decline at 36 hours. Consistently, IFN-α and IFN-β levels exhibited a similar time-dependent pattern, with early elevation and subsequent reduction. Conclusion: These findings suggest that DDX58 may exert a context- and time-dependent regulatory effect on EV-A71 replication and antiviral signaling. The observed transient activation of downstream pathways despite DDX58 knockdown indicates potential involvement of compensatory innate immune mechanisms. Further studies are required to elucidate the underlying molecular interactions.

title: Enterovirus A71 upregulates and recruits host ATF3 to promote viral replication.
abstract: To hijack cellular resources, certain viruses such as EV-A71, induce the shutoff of cellular transcription and translation systems globally for establishing infection. However, our previous studies have shown that the translation efficiency of series host proteins is upregulated during EV-A71 infection potentially, including activating transcription factor 3 (ATF3). Here, we validated in RD cells that ATF3 is mount up during EV-A71 infection significantly via increasing mRNA and cap-independent translation. Our findings highlight the critical role of ATF3 in EV-A71 replication: during EV-A71 infection, ATF3 trans-locates to the cytoplasm besides upregulated, where it interacts with the viral 5' untranslated region (5'UTR) and promotes the replication of viral genome RNA. Intriguingly, the nuclear localization signal (NLS) of ATF3 also contributes to this process, including binding to the viral genome and facilitating viral replication.
journal: The international journal of biochemistry & cell biology

analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究在RD细胞中进行,重点关注EV-A71感染,以检查病毒复制过程中ATF3的上调和亚细胞定位。
analysis_zh.methods: 研究人员通过 EV-A71 感染期间 mRNA 的增加和帽独立翻译验证了 RD 细胞中 ATF3 的上调,并评估了其向细胞质的易位以及与病毒 5' 非翻译区 (5'UTR) 的相互作用。
analysis_zh.main_results: ATF3 在 EV-A71 感染期间显着上调并易位到细胞质,在细胞质中与病毒 5'UTR 相互作用并促进 基因组 RNA 复制。此外,ATF3 的核定位信号 (NLS) 通过与病毒 基因组 结合而促进了这一过程。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现揭示了 EV-A71 利用 ATF3 增强其复制的新机制,强调了 宿主 与病毒相互作用在病毒 发病机制 中的重要性。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果提供了对 EV-A71 分子策略的见解,可以为靶向 抗病毒药物 疗法的开发提供信息,并提高对肠道病毒复制动力学的理解。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于 RD 细胞的体外观察,证据基于单一实验模型,这可能会影响研究结果在体内条件下的普遍性。证据强度中等。

title: Detection of novel Echovirus 25 lineage from patients and sewage in Fukuoka in 2024
abstract: Echovirus 25 (E25), belonging to the Enterovirus B species of viruses, is known to cause infectious gastroenteriris, aseptic meningitis, and acute flaccid paralysis. Our study aims to conduct enterovirus surveillance and subsequent molecular epidemiology investigations among patients and sewage samples in Fukuoka. In 2024, a total of ten and seven enteroviral strains were detected in 141 clinical specimens and 24 sewage samples, respectively. Among them, five E25 strains were identified, and phylogenetic analysis of VP1 region revealed that these strains constituted a distinct clade separated from previously reported E25 strains. Full-length genome sequences were determined using sequence-independent, single-primer amplification and next-generation sequencing. The five strains had sequence identities ranging from 99.0% to 99.9% among themselves. Through phylogenetic analysis, the five strains were classified as E25 on the basis of P1, and P1–3 sequences, and as E3 and E11 on the basis of P2–3 sequence. Furthermore, SimPlot and RDP4 analysis revealed a unique recombination event between the detected E25 strains and E3 in the region of the 2B gene, which is the non-structural region. These findings indicated the emergence of a novel E25 lineage in 2024, and underscore the importance of continued surveillance to monitor its evolution and circulation.

title: Enterovirus A71 neuroinvasion: central nervous system entry, blood–brain barrier dynamics, and multistage constraints
abstract: Enterovirus A71 (EV-A71) is an important cause of severe neurological complications of hand, foot, and mouth disease in children. Most infections remain confined to peripheral sites, whereas only a small proportion progress to central nervous system (CNS) disease, and the mechanisms underlying this transition remain incompletely understood. Here, we reappraise EV-A71 neuropathogenesis as a multistage process comprising peripheral replication, systemic dissemination, CNS entry, establishment of productive CNS infection, and subsequent tissue injury. This distinction is important because these events are mechanistically connected but not interchangeable. Current evidence supports both neurovascular and peripheral neural routes of CNS entry, although the nature and strength of the supporting evidence differ. Human-derived blood–brain barrier (BBB) models demonstrate that EV-A71 and virus-associated carriers can engage and cross neurovascular interfaces, whereas temporal studies in animals, perturbation of axonal transport, and compartmentalized neuronal models provide stronger causal support for retrograde axonal transport once the virus has accessed peripheral nerves. These findings establish mechanistic feasibility, but the timing, necessity, and relative contribution of each route during natural infection in children remain unresolved. We further emphasize that BBB crossing is not synonymous with BBB disruption, and that CNS entry does not necessarily result in productive CNS infection. On this basis, we propose a multistage progression-constraint model, in which progression to severe neurological disease requires EV-A71 to overcome distinct constraints imposed by tissue context, viral properties, and host factors at successive stages. analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the mechanisms of Enterovirus A71 (EV-A71) neuroinvasion, focusing on how it transitions from peripheral sites to the central nervous system (CNS) in children. The research highlights the multistage process of EV-A71 neuropathogenesis, including peripheral replication, systemic dissemination, CNS entry, and tissue injury. It identifies both neurovascular and peripheral neural routes as potential pathways for CNS entry, though the evidence supporting these routes varies in strength. The study emphasizes that BBB crossing does not equate to BBB disruption and that CNS entry may not always lead to productive infection. The findings suggest the need for longitudinal clinical studies and experimental models to better understand the divergence of disease trajectories. However, the study acknowledges unresolved questions about the timing and relative contribution of each route during natural infection.

title: Enterovirus infection in clinical practice
abstract: Enteroviruses are well-known causes of a wide range of infectious diseases, ranging from mild illnesses such as typical exanthema to severe conditions such as serous meningitis. Given the continued relevance of the disease, the potential for severe progression, and the lack of specific prophylaxis, epidemiological vigilance is necessary for enteroviral and its various forms. This article examines the clinical presentation of the most common forms of enteroviral infection.

title: Search Strategy for a Review of the Diagnostic Landscape of Enterovirus A71 (EV-A71)
abstract: This scoping review aims to map the existing evidence on the diagnostic landscape of Enterovirus A71 (EV-A71). The review aims to identify and characterise existing and emerging diagnostic approaches for EV-A71 detection, including molecular, antigen-based, and other diagnostic methods. Diagnostic performance metrics will be recorded for those commercially available and in publication. This review will identify any gaps in the diagnostic landscape and make recommendations to overcome gaps and challenges. title: Đặc điểm dịch tễ học của các ca bệnh tay chân miệng nặng do Coxsackievirus A6 và đặc điểm di truyền của một số chủng tại miền Nam Việt Nam, 2022–2025 Circulation and preliminary genetic characterization of Coxsackievirus A6 causing severe hand, foot and mouth disease in southern Vietnam, 2022– 2025
abstract: Coxsackievirus A6 (CV-A6) hiện là một trong những tác nhân quan trọng gây bệnh Tay Chân Miệng (TCM) phổ biến tại Việt Nam và ngày càng được ghi nhận trong các trường hợp biểu hiện bệnh nặng. Nghiên cứu này nhằm phân tích một số đặc điểm dịch tễ của các trường hợp Tay Chân Miệng nặng do CV-A6 và khảo sát đặc điểm di truyền của một số chủng CV-A6 tại miền Nam Việt Nam giai đoạn 2022–2025. Nghiên cứu được thực hiện trên các trường hợp mắc TCM thu thập trong giai đoạn 2022-2025. VRĐR và CV-A6 được phát hiện bằng kỹ thuật real-time RT-PCR. Các mẫu dương tính với CV-A6 được phân lập, giải trình tự vùng gen VP1 và phân tích phát sinh loài nhằm xác định mối quan hệ di truyền. Trong tổng số 1.974 trường hợp nghi ngờ TCM, có 1.179 trường hợp dương tính với VRĐR (59,7%), CV-A6 được phát hiện ở 83 trường hợp, tương ứng với 7% số ca dương tính với VRĐR. Nhóm nhiễm CV-A6 chủ yếu là nam giới (63,9%) và trẻ từ 1–2 tuổi (63,9%). Trong số các mẫu CV-A6 dương tính, có 4 mẫu được phân lập thành công. Kết quả giải trình tự vùng gen VP1 cho thấy tất cả các chủng đều thuộc phân nhánh D3c của dòng D3. Đây là bằng chứng về sự hiện diện của phân nhánh D3c trong các trường hợp TCM nặng tại miền Nam Việt Nam giai đoạn 2022–2025. Kết quả nhấn mạnh vai trò của giám sát dịch tễ học phân tử liên tục nhằm theo dõi sự tiến hóa và lưu hành của VRĐR, góp phần cung cấp cơ sở khoa học cho công tác phòng và kiểm soát TCM.

source_records.abstract: Coxsackievirus A6 (CV-A6) hiện là một trong những tác nhân quan trọng gây bệnh Tay Chân Miệng (TCM) phổ biến tại Việt Nam và ngày càng được ghi nhận trong các trường hợp biểu hiện bệnh nặng. Nghiên cứu này nhằm phân tích một số đặc điểm dịch tễ của các trường hợp Tay Chân Miệng nặng do CV-A6 và khảo sát đặc điểm di truyền của một số chủng CV-A6 tại miền Nam Việt Nam giai đoạn 2022–2025. Nghiên cứu được thực hiện trên các trường hợp mắc TCM thu thập trong giai đoạn 2022-2025. VRĐR và CV-A6 được phát hiện bằng kỹ thuật real-time RT-PCR. Các mẫu dương tính với CV-A6 được phân lập, giải trình tự vùng gen VP1 và phân tích phát sinh loài nhằm xác định mối quan hệ di truyền. Trong tổng số 1.974 trường hợp nghi ngờ TCM, có 1.179 trường hợp dương tính với VRĐR (59,7%), CV-A6 được phát hiện ở 83 trường hợp, tương ứng với 7% số ca dương tính với VRĐR. Nhóm nhiễm CV-A6 chủ yếu là nam giới (63,9%) và trẻ từ 1–2 tuổi (63,9%). Trong số các mẫu CV-A6 dương tính, có 4 mẫu được phân lập thành công. Kết quả giải trình tự vùng gen VP1 cho thấy tất cả các chủng đều thuộc phân nhánh D3c của dòng D3. Đây là bằng chứng về sự hiện diện của phân nhánh D3c trong các trường hợp TCM nặng tại miền Nam Việt Nam giai đoạn 2022–2025. Kết quả nhấn mạnh vai trò của giám sát dịch tễ học phân tử liên tục nhằm theo dõi sự tiến hóa và lưu hành của VRĐR, góp phần cung cấp cơ sở khoa học cho công tác phòng và kiểm soát TCM.

title_original: Đặc điểm dịch tễ học của các ca bệnh tay chân miệng nặng do Coxsackievirus A6 và đặc điểm di truyền của một số chủng tại miền Nam Việt Nam, 2022–2025 Circulation and preliminary genetic characterization of Coxsackievirus A6 causing severe hand, foot and mouth disease in southern Vietnam, 2022– 2025

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to analyze the epidemiological characteristics of severe hand, foot and mouth disease (HFMD) cases caused by Coxsackievirus A6 (CV-A6) and to investigate the genetic characteristics of some CV-A6 strains in southern Vietnam from 2022 to 2025. This addresses the need to understand the epidemiology and genetic diversity of CV-A6, which is a significant cause of HFMD in Vietnam.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study was conducted on HFMD cases collected from 2022 to 2025 in southern Vietnam. The design involved real-time RT-PCR for virus detection and sequencing of the VP1 region to determine genetic characteristics.
analysis.methods: HFMD cases were identified using real-time RT-PCR, and successful isolation and sequencing of the VP1 region were performed on positive samples to analyze genetic diversity.
analysis.main_results: Out of 1,974 suspected HFMD cases, 1,179 (59.7%) were positive for viral RNA (VR), and CV-A6 was detected in 83 cases (7% of VR-positive cases). The infection was predominantly in male children aged 1-2 years.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The study identified the presence of CV-A6 in severe HFMD cases and found that all sequenced strains belonged to the D3c sublineage of the D3 lineage, providing evidence of the circulation of D3c in southern Vietnam during the study period.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings highlight the importance of continuous molecular epidemiological surveillance to monitor the evolution and circulation of enteroviruses, which can inform scientific and public health strategies for HFMD prevention and control.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by the sample size and the fact that only a subset of positive samples were sequenced. The evidence strength is moderate due to these limitations.

analysis.summary_en: This study analyzed the epidemiological characteristics and genetic diversity of Coxsackievirus A6 (CV-A6) causing severe hand, foot and mouth disease (HFMD) in southern Vietnam from 2022 to 2025. Out of 1,974 suspected cases, 83 (7%) were positive for CV-A6, with infections predominantly in young male children. Sequencing showed all strains belonged to the D3c sublineage, indicating the circulation of this strain in the region.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在分析柯萨奇病毒A6(CV-A6)引起的重症手足口病(HFMD)病例的流行病学特征,并调查2022年至2025年越南南部部分CV-A6毒株的遗传特征。这解决了了解CV-A6的流行病学和遗传多样性的需要,CV-A6是越南手足口病的重要病因。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究针对 2022 年至 2025 年在越南南部收集的手足口病病例进行。该设计涉及用于病毒检测的实时 RT-PCR 以及对 VP1 区域进行测序以确定遗传特征。
elements_zh.methods: 使用实时 RT-PCR 鉴定手足口病病例,并对阳性样本成功分离 VP1 区域并进行测序,以分析遗传多样性。
elements_zh.main_results: 在 1,974 例疑似手足口病病例中,1,179 例(59.7%)病毒 RNA(VR)阳性,83 例(VR 阳性病例的 7%)检测到 CV-A6。感染主要发生在1-2岁的男性儿童中。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究鉴定了严重手足口病病例中存在CV-A6,并发现所有测序菌株均属于D3谱系的D3c亚谱系,为研究期间D3c在越南南部的传播提供了证据。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果强调了连续分子流行病学 监测 监测 进化 和肠道病毒传播的重要性,这可以为手足口病预防和控制的科学和公共卫生策略提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受到样本量的限制,并且仅对一部分阳性样本进行了测序。由于这些限制,证据强度中等。

title: Evaluating the antiviral effects of polygonum cuspidatum nanoparticles against enterovirus 71 in vitro and in vivo.
abstract: Enterovirus 71 (EV71) is a major causative agent of hand, foot, and mouth disease (HFMD) and is associated with severe neurological complications in young children. However, effective antiviral therapeutics remain limited. In this study, nanoparticles derived from Polygonum cuspidatum (NPC) were prepared and their antiviral activity against EV71 was evaluated in vitro and in vivo. Cytotoxicity and antiviral assays in human rhabdomyosarcoma (RD) cells demonstrated that NPC exhibited substantially lower cytotoxicity than the crude extract while maintaining comparable antiviral potency against EV71. NPC treatment markedly reduced EV71-induced cytopathic effects and significantly decreased viral RNA levels, as confirmed by indirect immunofluorescence and RT-qPCR. In an EV71-infected ICR suckling mouse model, oral administration of NPC significantly improved survival, attenuated clinical disease scores and body weight loss, and reduced viral loads in muscle and brain tissues in a dose-dependent manner. Histopathological analysis revealed alleviated tissue injury in the NPC-treated mice. These findings suggest that nanonization improves the therapeutic index of P. cuspidatum and support further investigation of NPC as a potential plant-derived antiviral candidate for EV71 infection.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在评估虎杖纳米颗粒 (NPC) 对肠道病毒 71 (EV71) 的 抗病毒药物 作用,肠道病毒是手足口病 (HFMD) 的主要病原体,并与幼儿严重的神经系统并发症相关。有效的 抗病毒药物 疗法仍然有限。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究使用人横纹肌肉瘤 (RD) 细胞在体外评估了 NPC 对抗 EV71 的 抗病毒药物 活性,并使用感染 EV71 的 ICR 乳鼠模型在体内评估了 NPC 对抗 EV71 的 抗病毒药物 活性。
elements_zh.methods: 制备 NPC,并通过 RD 细胞和 EV71 感染的 ICR 乳鼠模型中的细胞毒性和 抗病毒药物 测定来评估其 抗病毒药物 活性。
elements_zh.main_results: NPC 表现出比粗提物更低的细胞毒性,同时保持与 抗病毒药物 相当的针对 EV71 的效力。在体内,NPC 治疗 以剂量依赖的方式提高了生存率,减轻了临床疾病评分,减少了体重减轻,并降低了肌肉和脑组织中的病毒载量。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现表明,纳米化提高了虎杖的治疗指数,并支持进一步研究 NPC 作为 EV71 感染的潜在植物源 抗病毒药物 候选药物。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,NPC 可能是治疗 EV71 感染的有前景的 抗病毒药物 候选药物,有可能改善 治疗 的结果并减少幼儿的严重神经系统并发症。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的局限性包括使用单一动物模型以及需要进一步研究以证实人体临床试验的结果。由于样本量有限且需要重复,证据强度中等。

abstract_zh: 肠道病毒 71 (EV71) 是手足口病 (HFMD) 的主要病原体,并与幼儿的严重神经系统并发症有关。然而,有效的 抗病毒药物 疗法仍然有限。在这项研究中,制备了虎杖 (NPC) 衍生的纳米颗粒,并在体外和体内评估了它们针对 EV71 的 抗病毒药物 活性。人横纹肌肉瘤 (RD) 细胞中的细胞毒性和 抗病毒药物 测定表明,NPC 表现出比粗提物低得多的细胞毒性,同时保持与 EV71 相当的 抗病毒药物 效力。间接免疫荧光和 RT-qPCR 证实,NPC 治疗 显着降低了 EV71 诱导的细胞病变效应,并显着降低了病毒 RNA 水平。在感染 EV71 的 ICR 乳鼠模型中,口服 NPC 可显着提高生存率,减轻临床疾病评分和体重减轻,并以剂量​​依赖性方式减少肌肉和脑组织中的病毒载量。组织病理学分析显示,经 NPC 治疗的小鼠的组织损伤减轻。这些发现表明纳米化提高了虎杖的治疗指数,并支持进一步研究 NPC 作为 EV71 感染的潜在植物源 抗病毒药物 候选者。

title: Transcriptome analysis of mRNA and long non-coding RNA profiles in the brains of CVA10-infected suckling mice.
abstract: Hand, foot, and mouth disease (HFMD) caused by Coxsackievirus A10 (CVA10) remains an important public health concern. Although most infections are self-limiting, severe cases may develop neurological complications, including acute flaccid paralysis and aseptic meningitis. However, host transcriptional responses to CVA10 infection within the central nervous system (CNS) remain poorly understood. Here, we established a CVA10-infected ICR suckling mouse model and performed transcriptomic profiling of brain tissues using RNA-seq, followed by RT-qPCR validation. A total of 243 differentially expressed mRNAs and 776 differentially expressed lncRNAs were identified in the brains of CVA10-infected mice. Interferon-stimulated genes (ISGs) such as Ifit1 exhibited significant dysregulation in CVA10-infected brain tissue. Integrated GO and KEGG functional enrichment analyses revealed that these genes were significantly associated with innate immune and inflammatory responses, particularly interferon-related signaling pathways. title: Hand, Foot, and Mouth Disease with Probable Intrafamilial Transmission in a 15-Month-Old Infant: A Case Report
abstract: Hand, foot, and mouth disease (HFMD) is an acute exanthema disease caused by a viral infection which is generally self-limiting, most often caused by Coxsackievirus A16 and Enterovirus 71, and more often attacks children under five years of age. Problem: Transmission within the family through direct contact with secretions or lesion fluid from infected individuals is a recognized transmission route, however case reports that specifically state the possibility of intrafamilial transmission in children under two years old are still rare in the literature. Case report: We report a case of HFMD in a 15 month old boy who was brought to the outpatient facility with complaints of reddish rashes around the mouth, hands and feet since two days previously, preceded by fever as a prodromal symptom. Physical examination showed maculopapular and vesicular lesions in the perioral region, right wrist, and bilateral lower extremities, with generalized distribution and miliary to lenticular size. A history of close contact with an older sibling who experienced similar symptoms approximately one week previously supports the possibility of intrafamilial transmission between siblings. Management: The diagnosis is made clinically without laboratory supporting examinations. The patient received supportive treatment in the form of paracetamol syrup, 2% mupirocin ointment, and immunostimulants, accompanied by education to parents regarding hand hygiene and isolating the patient from other family members. Conclusion: This case emphasizes the importance of a systematic history of intrafamilial contact history in children with suspected HFMD, as well as the need for targeted family education to break the chain of transmission in the household environment.

title: Factors Contributing to Polio Vaccine Refusal among Families in Kabul, Kunduz, Faryab, and Jawzjan Provinces, Afghanistan, 2024
abstract: Abstract Background Vaccine refusal remains a major challenge to polio eradication in Afghanistan, one of the two remaining countries endemic for wild poliovirus type 1. Understanding the factors influencing vaccine refusal is essential for designing effective interventions to improve vaccination uptake. Methods A descriptive cross-sectional study was conducted in 2024 among 698 caregivers or household decision-makers from families that refused polio vaccination in Kabul, Kunduz, Faryab, and Jawzjan provinces. Participants were selected from refusal household lists maintained by the Expanded Programme on Immunization (EPI). Data were collected using a structured questionnaire assessing sociodemographic characteristics, routine immunization status, knowledge of poliomyelitis and polio vaccination, and reasons for vaccine refusal. Descriptive statistics were used to summarize the findings. Results Among the 698 respondents, 62.2% were male and 65.5% were aged 21–40 years. A total of 1,658 children were identified, of whom 89.8% had not received polio vaccination despite 97.6% of households reporting visits by house-to-house vaccination teams. Routine immunization coverage was low among refusal households, with overall coverage ranging from 40% to 48% across vaccine antigens. Although 57.3% of respondents reported knowledge of poliomyelitis and 71.3% were aware of the polio vaccine, only 38.1% believed that vaccination was useful for disease prevention. The most common reasons for vaccine refusal were family opposition (41.8%), vaccine mistrust (34.2%), religious concerns (31.4%), safety concerns (27.8%), fear of side effects (27.5%), and perceived vaccine ineffectiveness (25.8%). Misconceptions regarding infertility, immune-system effects, premature puberty, and illness following vaccination were also frequently reported. Access-related barriers were uncommon (6.3%). Conclusion Polio vaccine refusal in Afghanistan is driven primarily by family decision-making, mistrust, religious concerns, safety perceptions, and misinformation rather than access to vaccination services. Strengthening community engagement, risk communication, and trust-building initiatives while addressing misconceptions through culturally appropriate interventions may improve vaccine acceptance and support polio eradication efforts.

full_text: AbstractBackgroundPlastic bronchitis (PB) is a rare disease characterized by the formation of tree-like or tubular mucus plugs within the bronchi, which can lead to severe airway obstruction and respiratory failure, potentially becoming life-threatening if diagnosis and treatment are delayed. Enterovirus D68 (EV-D68) is a common pathogen that causes acute respiratory infections in children,which can lead to wheezing, acute flaccid myelitis, and even respiratory failure. Nevertheless, a direct association between EV-D68 infection and plastic bronchitis has not been previously reported. As the first documented case, this report establishes the association between EV-D68 and plastic bronchitis, thereby expanding the clinical spectrum of EV-D68.MethodsWe report a case of plastic bronchitis and severe pneumonia caused by Enterovirus D68 infection. To identify additional cases and elucidate the clinical characteristics of this condition, a systematic literature search was conducted using PubMed, Embase, and Web of Science databases for the period from January 2006 to June 2026. The search strategy employed the following keywords: “Enterovirus D68” “plastic bronchitis” and “severe pneumonia”.Case descriptionThis case involved an 11-year-old girl with previously good health. Chief complaints: cough and wheezing for 1 day, chest pain for half a day. Chest CT showed patchy increased-density opacities in the left upper loben with reduced left upper lobe volume, small nodular increased-density opacities in the left lower lobe and right lower lobe, right pleural thickening. Following admission, two flexible bronchoscopic examinations with plastic cast removal and bronchoalveolar lavage (BAL) were performed; bronchoscopic findings were consistent with plastic bronchitis and bronchial mucosal inflammation. Targeted next-generation sequencing (tNGS) of bronchoalveolar lavage fluid(BALF) detected Enterovirus D68 and Rhinovirus. Intravenous immunoglobulin support and methylprednisolone anti-inflammatory therapy were also administered. By hospital day 10, the patient's condition had stabilized;Follow-up chest CT demonstrated resolution of the left upper lobe patchy high-density opacities with re-expansion of the left upper lobe, patchy high-density opacities in the left lower lobe and small left pleural effusion. The newly developed lesion in the left lower lobe was considered resolving inflammatory changes rather than new active infection. The patient was discharged with medication. At 6 days post-discharge, follow-up chest CT demonstrated complete resolution of pulmonary infiltrates, pleural effusions, consistent with full clinical recovery. The total duration of treatment was 10 days of hospitalization plus 6 days of oral therapy after discharge, giving a total of 16 days.ConclusionEV-D68 infection should be recognized as a potential etiology of plastic bronchitis or severe pneumonia in children. In addition to direct pathogen-mediated tissue injury, immune-mediated damage warrants careful consideration in the underlying pathophysiological mechanisms. Early bronchoscopic intervention combined with anti-inflammatory and immunomodulatory therapy may prove critical in shortening the disease course and improving clinical outcomes.Keywords: case report, Enterovirus D68, plastic bronchitis, rhinovirus, severe pneumonia Supplementary materialThe Supplementary Material for this article can be found online at: https://www.frontiersin.org/articles/10.3389/fmed.2026.1977512/full#supplementary-material Supplementary Materials DiscussionThe case, confirmed by flexible bronchoscopy procedures with plastic cast removal and BAL were performed and BALF tNGS with detailed therapeutic documentation, provides valuable insights into the rare association between EV-D68 and plastic bronchitis in older children. All of the above support our argument of airway obstruction. Based on the histopathological findings in this patient, infection-related PB was considered. Second, for patients with rapidly progressive disease accompanied by hypoxemia and radiological deterioration, early bronchoscopic examination is warranted; the removal of plastic secretions and tNGS-based pathogen identification are critical for diagnosis and targeted therapy. Third, complete recovery was achieved after 16 days of comprehensive treatment incorporating repeated bronchoscopic lavage combined with intravenous immunoglobulin and methylprednisolone, suggesting that aggressive multimodal intervention may be pivotal for favorable outcomes in EV-D68–associated severe PB.In this case, histopathological examination of the plastic sputum cast revealed necrotic debris containing histiocytes, lymphocytes, eosinophils, and abundant neutrophils. title_original: Enterovirus D68 infection causing plastic bronchitis and severe pneumonia: a case report and literature review

analysis.scope_and_question: This review investigates the association between Enterovirus D68 (EV-D68) and plastic bronchitis in children, focusing on the clinical presentation, diagnostic methods, and treatment outcomes of a rare case. The central question is whether EV-D68 can cause plastic bronchitis and severe pneumonia, expanding the known clinical spectrum of this infection.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is based on a case report and a systematic literature search conducted using PubMed, Embase, and Web of Science databases from January 2006 to June 2026. The search strategy included the keywords 'Enterovirus D68', 'plastic bronchitis', and 'severe pneumonia'. Two flexible bronchoscopic examinations with plastic cast removal and bronchoalveolar lavage (BAL) were performed, and targeted next-generation sequencing (tNGS) of BAL fluid detected EV-D68 and Rhinovirus.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The case report confirms that EV-D68 can induce plastic bronchitis in previously healthy school-aged children, leading to airway obstruction, respiratory distress, and even respiratory failure. The patient's condition improved with 16 days of comprehensive treatment, including repeated bronchoscopic lavage, intravenous immunoglobulin, and methylprednisolone, suggesting that aggressive multimodal intervention may be pivotal for favorable outcomes. The findings also support the argument that EV-D68 infection is a potential etiology of plastic bronchitis or severe pneumonia in children.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review notes that while EV-D68 has been associated with acute flaccid myelitis (AFM), its potential to trigger severe lower airway disease with plastic cast formation remains underappreciated. There is no explicit mention of other related viruses like Rhinovirus being the primary cause of the condition, and the evidence is limited to a single case report. The review does not provide a comprehensive analysis of the pathophysiological mechanisms or long-term outcomes of EV-D68-associated plastic bronchitis.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The clinical significance of recognizing plastic bronchitis in the context of EV-D68 outbreaks includes the need for early bronchoscopic intervention for cast removal and airway clearance, which directly impacts survival. The inflammatory mechanisms underlying EV-D68-associated PB, particularly immune-mediated injury and eosinophilic infiltration, may inform targeted therapeutic strategies such as corticosteroids and immunoglobulin therapy. Heightened awareness among clinicians during EV-D68 epidemic seasons may facilitate timely diagnosis and reduce delays in definitive management.

analysis.summary_en: This case report and literature review explore the rare association between Enterovirus D68 (EV-D68) and plastic bronchitis in children. The study describes an 11-year-old girl with previously good health who developed plastic bronchitis and severe pneumonia, confirmed by bronchoscopy and tNGS of BAL fluid. The case highlights the clinical spectrum of EV-D68, including airway obstruction, respiratory distress, and even respiratory failure. The patient's recovery after 16 days of multimodal treatment suggests that aggressive interventions may be critical for favorable outcomes. The review emphasizes the need for early bronchoscopic examination and targeted therapies in EV-D68-associated PB, while noting that the pathophysiological mechanisms and long-term outcomes remain underexplored. The findings underscore the importance of recognizing EV-D68 as a potential cause of severe lower airway disease in children.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 本综述调查了肠道病毒 D68 (EV-D68) 与儿童塑料性支气管炎之间的关联,重点关注一例罕见病例的临床表现、诊断方法和 治疗 结果。核心问题是 EV-D68 是否会引起塑料性支气管炎和严重肺炎,从而扩大这种感染的已知临床范围。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该综述基于病例报告以及2006年1月至2026年6月使用PubMed、Embase和Web of Science数据库进行的系统文献检索。检索策略包括关键词“肠道病毒D68”、“塑料性支气管炎”和“严重肺炎”。进行了两次柔性支气管镜检查,包括塑料铸型去除和支气管肺泡灌洗(BAL),并且BAL液的靶向下一代测序(tNGS)检测到EV-D68和鼻病毒。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 病例报告证实EV-D68可诱发原本健康的学龄儿童塑性支气管炎,导致气道阻塞、呼吸窘迫,甚至呼吸衰竭。经过 16 天的综合 治疗(包括反复支气管镜灌洗、静脉注射免疫球蛋白和甲泼尼龙)后,患者的病情有所改善,这表明积极的多模式干预可能是获得良好结果的关键。研究结果还支持以下观点:EV-D68 感染是儿童塑料性支气管炎或重症肺炎的潜在病因。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 该评论指出,虽然 EV-D68 与 急性弛缓性脊髓炎 (AFM) 有关,但其引发严重下呼吸道疾病并形成塑料铸型的可能性仍然未被充分认识。没有明确提及其他相关病毒(例如鼻病毒)是该病症的主要原因,并且证据仅限于单个 病例报告。该综述并未对 EV-D68 相关塑料支气管炎的病理生理机制或长期结果进行全面分析。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 在 EV-D68 暴发 背景下识别塑料性支气管炎的临床意义包括需要早期支气管镜干预以去除管型和清除气道,这直接影响生存。EV-D68 相关 PB 的炎症机制,特别是免疫介导的损伤和嗜酸性粒细胞浸润,可能为皮质类固醇和免疫球蛋白治疗等靶向治疗策略提供信息。EV-D68 流行季节期间临床医生的认识提高可能有助于及时 诊断 并减少最终管理的延误。

title: Ferritin-displayed engineered sCAR1 nanoparticles as a receptor-decoy antiviral strategy against Coxsackievirus B-associated inflammation
abstract: Coxsackievirus Group B (CVB) remains an important cause of severe disease in infants and young children, including viral myocarditis and meningitis, yet no licensed vaccine or virus-specific antiviral therapy is currently available. Here, we engineered soluble Coxsackievirus and adenovirus receptor (CAR) ectodomains and displayed the optimized receptor decoy on ferritin nanoparticles to generate a potent anti-CVB3 entry inhibitor. Wild-type soluble CAR ectodomains neutralized CVB3 but were limited by homodimerization and by residual binding to endogenous CAR/JAML, which was associated with dose-dependent mitogenic activity. Guided by structural information, we introduced mutations that abolished dimerization and CAR/JAML binding while preserving, and further improving, viral neutralization. Ferritin display of the optimized sCAR1 mutant enhanced multivalent presentation, systemic persistence, and tissue delivery. The resulting sCAR1 Mu+Ferritin nanoparticle achieved IC<sub>50</sub> values of 413 ng/mL in Vero cells and 140 ng/mL in SH-SY5Y cells. abstract_zh: B 组柯萨奇病毒 (CVB) 仍然是婴儿和幼儿严重疾病的重要原因,包括病毒性心肌炎和脑膜炎,但目前尚无获得许可的 疫苗 或病毒特异性 抗病毒药物 疗法。在这里,我们设计了可溶性柯萨奇病毒和腺病毒受体 (CAR) 胞外域,并将优化的受体诱饵展示在铁蛋白纳米粒子上,以产生有效的抗 CVB3 进入抑制剂。野生型可溶性 CAR 胞外域中和了 CVB3,但受到同源二聚化和与内源 CAR/JAML 的残留结合的限制,这与剂量依赖性有丝分裂活性相关。在结构信息的指导下,我们引入了 突变,它消除了二聚化和 CAR/JAML 结合,同时保留并进一步改善了病毒中和作用。优化的 sCAR1 突变体的铁蛋白展示增强了多价呈递、全身持久性和组织递送。所得的sCAR1 Mu+铁蛋白纳米颗粒在Vero细胞中达到413ng/mL的IC<sub>50</sub>值,在SH-SY5Y细胞中达到140ng/mL。在新生 BALB/c 小鼠中,预防性施用 sCAR1 Mu+铁蛋白(200 μg,攻击前 6 小时)可提供 68.75% 的针对致死性 CVB3 感染 (10<sup>3.5</sup> CCID<sub>50</sub>) 的保护,减少肝脏、脾脏、大脑和心脏中的病毒负荷,并减轻心肌炎和神经炎症,而无需持续的细胞因子激活。针对 CVB1 的交叉中和活性进一步支持了这种基于受体的平台的广度。这些发现将铁蛋白展示的工程 CAR 纳米颗粒确定为针对 CVB 感染的安全优化且具有 突变 弹性的 抗病毒药物 策略。
